output.brief: The fall in incidents is not real. Analysts at Brackwater confirmed about 37 incidents in September and 36 in October, in line with the roughly 38 a month before the migration. A script on a Brackwater jump host then moved 47 of them (23 in September, 24 in October) into the "Suspicious Activity–Monitoring" category. Each move happened 3h31m–3h42m after the case opened, just after the 4-hour containment-SLA warning was raised. Moved cases drop out of the containment and SLA figures, which is why containment shows 100% and the bonus looks triggered. The platform connector made no category changes, so this was deliberate manual action, not a platform fault. Auto-triage and the dropped rules don't explain the fall. Whether the dropped rules let attacks through is still unknown. I am fairly sure of this, though intent and any wrongdoing still need to be established. Do not approve the retainer cut or the 60k bonus. Next: reinstate the 47 cases. Have your own team and Halvard verify containment on each. Remove category-edit rights from the Brackwater integration role. Ask Brackwater for a written explanation. Hold any service-credit claim until the cases are verified.
